caption:
People are quitting jobs again. 💼

The BLS says job openings were 7.52 million in September, and quits rose by 321,000 to about 3.37 million, the most since May 2023.
Much of the jump came from restaurants and hotels.

When workers feel safe leaving, it usually means they think they can find better pay.
Would you switch jobs right now?
